overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board timely acknowledged the executive session minutes request and its planned review was not yet due when the complaint was filed. The AG declined to review the compliance-certificate allegation, which was resolved in OML 2017-22.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board's response to his January 26 request for executive session minutes did not follow the statutory review timeline.
allegations.key_passage: Because the action proposed by the Board had not yet occurred when the complainant filed his complaint on February 8, we find no violation of the law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged Board members filed their Open Meeting Law compliance certificates with the City Clerk only after being coached by the AG's office in a prior complaint.
allegations.key_passage: Because this issue was resolved in the previous determination, we decline to review it here.
